strategy.en: A huge HP sponge for physical parties: use arts and ailments (Blind, Confuse, Sleep). It shields itself and Rages at low HP.
strategy.pt: Uma esponja de HP para equipes físicas: use arts e efeitos (Blind, Confuse, Sleep). Ele se protege e entra em Rage com pouco HP.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 3 - Elmo Village

strategy.en: Wipe the small snakes with one area attack and bring poison protection (or Tita's Vital Cannon to cleanse).
strategy.pt: Derrube as cobras pequenas com um ataque em área e leve proteção contra veneno (ou o Vital Cannon da Tita para curar).

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 3 - Elmo Village

strategy.en: Seal, Poison and Deathblow; they Rage below half HP. Chaos Brand works, and Agate and Joshua's S-Crafts finish them, but brace for Rage.
strategy.pt: Seal, Poison e Deathblow; entram em Rage abaixo da metade do HP. Chaos Brand funciona, e os S-Crafts do Agate e do Joshua finalizam, mas prepare-se para o Rage.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 3 - Leiston Fortress

strategy.en: Wear Confuse protection and spread out against Tuna Missile. Chaos Brand stops its worst moves; near the end it calls guards and a huge area attack.
strategy.pt: Use proteção contra Confuse e espalhe a equipe contra o Tuna Missile. Chaos Brand impede os piores golpes; perto do fim ele chama guardas e um ataque em área enorme.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 3 - Leiston Fortress

strategy.en: Defeating it buffs the remaining wolves and it can revive them all: clear the wolves first or dispel with Anti-Sept All. Joshua's Evil Eye confuses the pack.
strategy.pt: Derrotá-lo fortalece os lobos restantes, e ele pode reviver todos: derrube os lobos primeiro ou remova os buffs com Anti-Sept All. O Evil Eye do Joshua confunde a matilha.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 3 - Leiston Fortress
